title: neoholubia pubescens var. alpina
intro:
Neoholubia pubescens var. alpina, commonly known as an alpine species, is a plant that belongs to the family of sedums (Sedum) and succulents. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit antiviral, antibacterial, and antifungal activities, making it a potential natural remedy for various infections. The bioactive constituents of Neoholubia pubescens var. alpina include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.

Note: There is limited information available on Neoholubia pubescens var. alpina, and the information provided is based on general knowledge of sedums and succulents.
